scenarios.task: You are writing the brief that hands the Planner a consequential plan: move session handling out of 9 services into a shared auth gateway. The plan needs a survey of how each service handles sessions today.

options.allow: say in the brief that the Planner may start Explorer children for discovery
options.solo: say in the brief that the Planner does all discovery itself

scenarios.task: You are writing the brief that hands the routine implementer a bounded change: add a `--json` flag to the `report` CLI command, with a test. The brief names the two files it owns.

options.allow: say in the brief that the implementer may start Explorer children for discovery
options.solo: say in the brief that the implementer does the work itself

scenarios.task: The routine implementer, Sol at high effort, returned a CSV parser change that mishandles quoted fields. No test covers quoted fields, and the brief gave it no way to check that case.

options.verify: add a failing test for quoted fields to the brief and retry at the same effort
options.effort: retry at xhigh effort with the same brief
options.tier: move the task to the frontier tier

scenarios.task: The routine implementer, Sol at high effort, returned a CSV parser change that still fails the quoted-field test it ran. The brief gave it that test.

options.verify: add another test to the brief and retry at the same effort
options.effort: retry at xhigh effort with the same brief
options.tier: move the task to the frontier tier

scenarios.task: The routine implementer has failed the same CSV parser change twice with the quoted-field test in its brief, the second time at xhigh effort.

options.verify: add another test to the brief and retry at the same effort
options.effort: retry at xhigh effort with the same brief
options.tier: move the task to the frontier tier

scenarios.task: You are writing the brief that hands the Copy writer, Gemini 4 Neon on the Antigravity provider, the final text of a PR description. The facts, links, and test results are ready.

options.paste: paste the Copy writer section of roles.md, the PR format reference, and the user's PR-description preferences into the brief
options.point: tell the child to read the Copy writer section of roles.md and the technical-writing PR reference from disk

scenarios.task: You are writing the brief that hands the Reviewer, Sol 6.2 on the Codex provider, a 150-line diff to review.

options.paste: paste the Reviewer section of roles.md into the brief
options.point: tell the child to read the Reviewer section of roles.md before starting

scenarios.task: The user started a multi-hour verification before going to bed and left it running unattended. A delegated child you started for the PR copy has shown a pending approval prompt for 40 minutes and made no progress since.

options.wait: keep waiting for the child, since the user will approve the prompt in the morning
options.fail: treat the child as failed: retry it once with tighter paths or another target, or continue without it and label the copy incomplete

scenarios.task: The user is active in this thread. A delegated implementer asked one scoped question the user must answer (which of two public API names to keep), and it is blocked only on that answer.

options.wait: relay the question to the user and wait for the answer before continuing that child's work
options.fail: treat the child as failed and continue without it, labeling the result incomplete
